name: Granules India Ltd
about: Granules India Ltd and its subsidiaries are primarily involved in the manufacturing and selling of Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs), Pharmaceutical Formulation Intermediates (PFIs) and Finished Dosages.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments[1] a) Finished Dosages (74% in FY26 vs 77% in FY25):[2] The company develops a range of oral dosage formulations, including immediate-release, extended-release, delayed-release, and multiparticulate pellet-based tablets and capsules, press-fit tablets, oral solutions, suspensions, and powders for oral solutions.
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.62%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.6% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.7% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 7.84% of profits over last 3 years
